subject: [PATCH v5 13/15] selftests/nfsd: add a per-netns rpcbind stub and the listener round-trips

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch adds a per-netns rpcbind stub to the selftests/nfsd module, allowing it to serve rpcbind from within each network namespace. The stub is used to register listeners and handle round-trips for various tests, including TCP, UDP, multiple listeners, and IPv6. The patch also includes test cases that cover create, add, and remove paths, as well as LISTENER_GET round trips. By serving rpcbind from within the namespace, the patch resolves issues with listener registration timeouts and ensures proper cleanup of network namespaces.
